summary: I changed one file, `solution/util.py`, and the visible suite now passes (3 passed). The bug was in the placeholder-name regex `_NAME`, which used a lazy quantifier (`[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*?`). With `re.match`, a lazy pattern stops at the shortest possible match, so it only ever matched the first character of a name. In `{name}`, that meant the character after the match was `a`, not `}`, and `render` raised "malformed placeholder" on every name longer than one character. Changing it to the greedy `[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*` makes it match the whole name. I read through the rest of `solution/core.py`, including escaped braces and how missing keys are collected and reported, and didn't need to change it.
